meta.title: ZainCash · Support workspace

review.copyFailed: Clipboard is unavailable. Select and copy the approved text manually.

citations.title: Cited policy evidence
citations.intro: Evidence saved with the original draft. These snapshots remain available if a source is reindexed or deleted; they do not validate later reply edits.
citations.missingBody: Passage snapshots are unavailable for these citation IDs. This can occur with legacy results; inspect the original source before relying on this draft.
citations.none: No cited policy evidence was saved for this result.
citations.help: Similarity is a retrieval signal, not confidence that a reply is correct.

knowledge.emptyFile: Choose a document that contains text.
knowledge.tooLarge: Choose a document smaller than 10 MB.
knowledge.noticeAccepted: {name}: indexing request accepted. Follow its status below.
knowledge.noticeAlreadyIndexed: {name} is already indexed; no new indexing was requested.
knowledge.noticeFailedStored: {name} is stored with a failed index. Review the error and choose Retry index.
knowledge.noticeNotQueued: {name} is stored, but indexing was not queued. Capacity may be full; choose Index document to try again.
knowledge.noticeStoredOnly: {name} is stored. Enable and configure knowledge indexing, then choose Index document.
knowledge.indexRunning: {name}: indexing is running. Status checks resumed.
knowledge.indexAccepted: {name}: indexing request accepted. Status checks resumed; waiting for a worker result.
knowledge.indexAcceptedAgain: {name}: indexing request accepted again. Status checks resumed; waiting for a worker result.
knowledge.indexFailedPending: The previous acceptance remains pending. Use Request indexing again when indexing is available.
knowledge.indexFailedKept: The stored source is retained. Retry when indexing is available.
knowledge.deleted: Document deleted. Saved citation evidence remains available in historical reviews.
knowledge.paused: Automatic status checks paused after 3 minutes. Accepted requests remain pending. Refresh status checks for a result; if no worker claim was recorded, use Request indexing again to request recovery.
knowledge.dropTitle: Give your team a shared source of truth
knowledge.dropBody: Upload policies, FAQs and support procedures. PDF, Markdown or text · up to 10 MB
knowledge.pendingHelp: Request accepted; waiting for the indexing worker. Last stored state: {status}.
knowledge.pendingRetry: If indexing stalls, use Request indexing again. Active requests are deduplicated; this does not cancel existing work.
knowledge.checkAndRetry: Check the document and indexing configuration, then retry.
knowledge.awaitingConfigured: Choose Index document to request indexing.
knowledge.awaitingUnconfigured: Indexing needs to be enabled and configured.
knowledge.emptyHint: Add your first synthetic support policy to get started.
knowledge.stepStoreBody: Your files are saved in PostgreSQL with a checksum.
knowledge.stepCiteBody: Ground the agent's draft in relevant policy passages.
knowledge.readinessUnavailable: Readiness is unavailable. Check the API connection.
knowledge.retrievalDisabled: Knowledge retrieval is disabled. Enable RAG to index and search.
knowledge.configureProvider: Configure the embedding provider to index and search policies.
knowledge.passagesReady: Indexed policy passages are available for grounded drafts.
knowledge.indexFirst: Index a policy successfully before expecting a grounded draft.
knowledge.credentialOff: Credential checking is not configured; affected drafts are marked for review.
knowledge.readinessScope: Readiness reflects configuration and stored indexes, not a live provider check.

knowledge.deleteBody: {name} and its searchable passages will be removed. Evidence already saved with a draft remains in that review.
knowledge.chunksStale: These may be passages from an earlier index. New drafts only use successfully published indexes.
knowledge.noChunksHint: Index this document successfully to inspect its passages.
